f1040.title: Form 1040 Generator | IRS Form 1040 Instructions & Tax Guide 2026
f1040.description: Fill out IRS Form 1040 online with clear Form 1040 instructions. Learn how to complete your tax return, report income and payments, and preview your 2026 Form 1040 free.

content.heading: IRS Form 1040 instructions and tax guide
paragraphs: Form 1040 is the U.S. individual income tax return. Our 1040 form generator lets you enter your income, deductions, credits and payments and see a completed sample Form 1040 for planning and your records.
Tax forms from Thi Pay Stubs are sample documents for your records and planning. File official forms with the IRS or SSA using the official versions or an authorized e-file provider.

items.title: 1. Filing status and personal information
items.text: Choose your filing status and enter your name, SSN and address (and your spouse’s, if filing jointly).

items.title: 2. Dependents
items.text: List qualifying children and other dependents you are claiming.

items.title: 3. Income
items.text: Report wages from your W-2s, plus interest, dividends, retirement distributions and other income.

items.title: 4. Adjustments and deductions
items.text: Subtract adjustments to income, then take the standard deduction or your itemized deductions.

items.title: 5. Tax and credits
items.text: Work out the tax on your taxable income and subtract credits such as the child tax credit.

items.title: 6. Payments
items.text: Enter federal income tax withheld (from your W-2s and 1099s) and any estimated tax payments.

items.title: 7. Refund or amount you owe
items.text: Compare your total tax with your payments to see your refund or the balance due, then sign and date the return.

faqs.question: Can I file this Form 1040 with the IRS?
faqs.answer: No. It is a sample for planning and your records. File your return through IRS Free File, an authorized e-file provider, or the official paper form.

faqs.question: What do I need before filling out Form 1040?
faqs.answer: Your W-2s and 1099s, records of other income, deductions and credits you plan to claim, and last year’s return for reference.

A W-9 gives a business that pays you the information it needs to issue a 1099. Send it to the person or company that requested it, not to the IRS.

steps.heading: How to fill out a W-9

items.title: Line 1–2: Name
items.text: Enter your name as shown on your tax return, and your business name if it is different.

items.title: Line 3: Tax classification
items.text: Choose individual/sole proprietor, C corporation, S corporation, partnership, trust/estate or LLC.

items.title: Lines 5–6: Address
items.text: Enter the address where you want to receive your information returns.

items.title: Part II: Certification
items.text: Sign and date the form, then send it to the requester.

faqs.answer: Independent contractors, freelancers and vendors usually complete a W-9 when a business that will pay them asks for their taxpayer details.

faqs.question: Do I send the W-9 to the IRS?
faqs.answer: No. Give it to the person or business that requested it. They use it to prepare your 1099.
